label: Blind sample 022: Hansen forest loss 2020, tile 50N_130W

verdict.headline: Not what was claimed
verdict.statement: Greenness (NDVI) fell by 0.06 relative to the control trajectory in the 18 months after 1 Jan 2020 (90% interval +0.00 to +0.06). The same test was run on 60 untouched control cells. In 27 of them the no-event prediction missed by as much after the event date, relative to how closely it matched before, as it did here (placebo p = 0.46). Counted by gap size instead, 8 of the 60 moved at least as far as this area did in the same direction (p = 0.15). That is the opposite of what the claimed event would do.
reasons: the area moved in the opposite direction to a clearing event

evidence.sentence: Neither optical nor radar shows a change beyond what the controls did.
